jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - FRANCE
jobs.description:
About Agicap 

 Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest growing scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 700 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France. 

 Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies. 

 We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024. 

 These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world. 

 We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure! 

 Cash is the lifeblood of every business, and it's the number one priority for CFOs. As a Mid-Market Account Executive, your mission is to grow our business by winning new customers in the French mid-market segment. 

 You own the full sales cycle, from discovery to signature, working with an SDR who feeds your pipeline. You don't just sell software: you position Agicap as a strategic partner for companies that want to transform how they manage cash. 

 What you'll do 
 Discovery & qualification 

• 

• Take ownership of the qualified opportunities passed on by the SDR team, from discovery through to signature.

• Run in-depth discovery sessions to understand each prospect's context, challenges, and cash flow needs.

• Identify concrete use cases for Agicap and build a clear ROI case tailored to each prospect.

• Work with your SDRs to define a sector-based development strategy and sharpen their outreach with your field feedback.

 Sales cycle management 

• 

• Deliver sharp product demos, based on the needs surfaced during discovery.

• Map all stakeholders and the buying process, and build strong relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, and other C-level decision-makers.

• Present offers, negotiate terms, and support prospects all the way to signature, to meet and exceed your targets.

 Cross-functional collaboration 

• 

• Share structured feedback with the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to keep improving our go-to-market and our product.

• Work with Customer Success to ensure a smooth handover and a strong onboarding.

• Share your commercial expertise and ideas to help the whole team grow.

 Performance management 

• 

• 

• Keep your pipeline data accurate and up to date in HubSpot.

• Review your performance regularly with your manager, spot areas to improve, and adjust your approach.

 What we are looking for: 

• Around 5 years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in SaaS and in the mid-market segment, or experience in a finance department / audit / consulting / TS.

• A clear track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

• Strong discovery and consultative selling skills: you start from the prospect's problem, not the product.

• Comfortable selling to CFOs and Finance Directors.

• Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and real intellectual curiosity.

• Discipline in using a CRM (HubSpot) and managing your pipeline.

• An entrepreneurial mindset: you're comfortable in a fast-moving environment and full of ideas.

• Fluent French and a good level of English.

• Nice to have: experience in treasury or finance software, an existing network in the French mid-market finance/CFO community, or experience in a scale-up or fintech.

 Why join Agicap 

• An exceptional product-market fit, on a critical need: cash, the number one priority for CFOs.

• A strongly differentiated solution, a leader in Europe (G2), in a huge market.

• A strong culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, a European scale-up (>50% of revenue outside France).

• Real opportunities to grow, both in your role and across countries: at Agicap, former Sales are now managers, Ops, recruiters… across the Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.

• A close-knit, talented team with real team spirit.

 Package & benefits 

• Attractive package: between €100K and €150K depending on profile and performance, with uncapped commissions.

• Swile meal vouchers: €11/day, with €6.50 covered by Agicap.

• 100% reimbursement of public transport.

• 1,000 m² offices in Vaise (Lyon 9ème).

• Latest-generation work equipment.

• Regular team events: afterworks, team lunches, football, running, monthly team building, and company offsites (the last one was on the privatised Île des Embiez in the South of France, for Agicap's 10th anniversary).

 AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Technical Advisory)
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar? 

 Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

 The impact you will have 

• Grow the usage of the Sonar solution within Accounts

• Increase the overall Account Sonar maturity

• Lower the risk of Account churn or downgrade

• Increase Account satisfaction, reduce the number of escalations

• Increase the number of Sonar sponsors in the Account

• Establish and maintain Sonar as a Trusted Advisor in the Account

• Entice Accounts to stay current on an Active version of Sonar, to get maximal value

• Influence Sonar roadmap to meet Account needs

 On a daily basis, you will 

• Actively listen and formalize Account technical pains or other adoption inhibitors

• Work on plans to overcome customer pains and inhibitors

• Report product technical or functional gaps internally and advocate for their resolution

• Evangelize/Promote the Sonar methodology to govern continuous Code Quality and Security improvements to the customer

• Assist Sonar sponsors in the Account for the promotion/evangelization of the Sonar ecosystem

• Keep Accounts up to date on the roadmap and aware of the value present in upcoming Sonar releases, as well as collecting feedback

• Recruit customer development teams not currently using Sonar “Upgrade” customer development teams that do not use Sonar correctly and therefore do not receive the maximum value

• Position (favorably) the Sonar ecosystem vs other competing products potentially still used in the Account

• Educate developers and managers on the value of static code analysis in general and of the Sonar ecosystem specifically

• Make sure that the Account's Sonar technical deployment and operations are in line with the size of the deployment and the criticality of the tool in the DevOps chain

• Run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) with Account Sales representatives

• Execute Sonar deployment audits, identify gaps, and drive remediation plans for Accounts

• Contribute to the Account Management plans with Sales Representatives. Elaborate the Technical strategy tailored to the Account context, provide inputs on the Commercial strategy

• Keep yourself constantly up to date knowledge of the technical status of the Account, technical progress, threats, and opportunities for improved maturity

• Track product development within Sonar in order to maintain product expertise

 The skills you will demonstrate 

• Proven practical experience (at least 5 years) in software development or DevOps engineering which sets the stage for understanding our products and how they’re enjoyed by users

• At least 5 years of experience in pre- or post-sales customer-facing activities

• High listening skills and the ability to formalize and abstract elements expressed by customers and partners

• Excellent presentation skills with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge

• Attention to details

• A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovationsAutonomy to run your activity/plans with limited supervision

 We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait . 
 Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
 Alan exists to end the wait.
 Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
 So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
 We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
 Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

 Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. 

 ⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job
 We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large or very large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

 Why is this segment interesting? 
 • Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

• Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

• Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

• HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

• Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

 Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

 What will you do with us? 
 You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies. 
 At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects . We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.
 We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).
 You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company , challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.
 Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis , both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀 

 ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?
 You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you: 
 • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

• Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English .

• Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills ;

• Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

• Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

• Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

• Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

• Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

• Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. 

 For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range .
 If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. 

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 
 At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.
 Therefore, we offer: 
 • Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

• Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

• All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

• Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

• Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

• Transport . Generous transit benefit

• Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

• Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . 

• Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

 Important note: we hire people, not roles. 
 If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.
 If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait . 
 Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
 Alan exists to end the wait.
 Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
 So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
 We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
 Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

 Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. 

 ⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job
 We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.
 You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.
 Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive. 

 Why is our Vertical approach interesting? 
 • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

• Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

• Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

• Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

 What will you do with us? 
 You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing . The average sales cycle is 4-6 months , dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€ .
 At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects . We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.
 We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).
 You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company , challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

 Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew. 

 ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?
 You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you: 
 • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

• Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English .

• Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills ;

• Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

• Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

• Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

• Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

• Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

• Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. 

 For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range .
 If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. 

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits 
 At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.
 Therefore, we offer: 
 • Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

• Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

• All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

• Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

• Delightful healthcare insurance:  Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

• Transport . Generous transit benefit

• Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

• Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.   Learn more about our coaching culture . 

• Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

 Important note: we hire people, not roles. 
 If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.
 If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?
 Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. 
 We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

jobs.description:
About IonQ: 

 IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

 Location: This role is based at our Geneva, Switzerland office, with the option to work two days a week remotely.
 Travel: Up to 10% 
Job ID: 1771

 The Role: 

 As a Product Manager within the Quantum Platform – Devices division, you will play a key role in supporting a growing portfolio of cutting-edge products by taking ownership of day-to-day product operations. You will ensure product features are clearly defined, tracked throughout every stage of the product lifecycle and delivered successfully across cross-functional teams. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing, you will translate market and customer insights into product features for refinement by engineering teams, while leading the triage, planning and coordination of special customer projects. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.

• 

• 
 Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.

• 
 Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.

• 
 Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.

 What you'll be doing: 

 You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. Acting as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, you will drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate delivery across multiple teams to ensure products are launched on time and to a high standard. This role is integral to enabling the Product team to scale effectively, providing operational ownership and supporting the successful delivery of an expanding product portfolio.

• 

• 
 Own the operational delivery of product management, ensuring features progress from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation.

• 
 Drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate timely delivery across the product lifecycle.

•

 What you'll bring: 

 In this role, you will take ownership of feature delivery from end to end, defining requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering handovers, validating delivery and supporting successful commercial launches. You will manage non-standard sales opportunities by assessing feasibility, making configuration decisions within agreed boundaries and documenting exceptions, while ensuring full traceability from customer requests through to delivered capability. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, you will coordinate cross-functional activities to remove blockers, maintain an accurate and prioritised Jira backlog, and respond to product enquiries from Sales. You will also prepare products for launch through documentation, training, pricing and sales enablement, maintain up-to-date product documentation, communicate complex photonic, cryogenic and networking architectures to a range of stakeholders, and represent the product in customer-facing activities including pre-sales support, technical discussions and trade shows.

•

•

• 
 Support successful product adoption by communicating complex technical architectures, ensuring launch readiness, providing pre-sales support and representing the product in customer discussions and at trade shows.

You will be able to understand and reason about complex hardware products involving photonics, cryogenics and networking technologies, while communicating effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. You will be comfortable representing products in customer-facing situations, including technical discussions, pre-sales meetings and trade shows, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing environments, including industrialisation constraints, production realities and supply chain considerations. You will also be confident resolving conflicting priorities, negotiating with stakeholders and developing deep expertise in quantum technologies, supported by advanced Jira proficiency, including workflow configuration, automation rules and custom field management.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar? 

 Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

 Position description 

 Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. Over time, you will lead initiatives across the company, in domains you may not know yet.

 What you will do 

• 
 Frame ambiguous strategic intents into clear problems, objectives and business cases, starting from the impact on our customers and the business.

• 
 Bring the customer voice into every initiative: use customer feedback and data to shape solutions, and make sure internal changes improve how customers buy, use and renew with Sonar.

• 
 Ground decisions in data: establish baselines, size opportunities, define success metrics up front and measure impact after go-live.

• 
 Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end, driving pace and keeping the focus on customer and business outcomes.

• 
 Re-plan quickly when priorities or context change, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

• 
 Redesign processes AI-first, from the outcome back: decide what AI agents do, where humans and AI work together and where human judgment stays essential, with guardrails proportional to business risk.

• 
 Build working prototypes (skills, agents, lightweight apps, automations) to test ideas early with users, then partner with Business Technology to industrialize what works.

• 
 Use AI agents systematically in your own business analysis and project management work, and share reusable skills and workflows to raise the AI bar around you.

• 
 Bridge leadership and operational teams: engage stakeholders early, manage competing priorities and keep sponsors and teams aligned.

• 
 Stay agile and pragmatic: run initiatives with simple, effective tools and communication rather than heavy process and admin, pick the approach that drives the behaviors and actions needed, re-plan quickly when context changes, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

• 
 Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them pragmatically: just enough process, simple tools and clear communication, never process for its own sake.

• 
 Own change management as part of delivery (communication, training, champions, reinforcement) until new ways of working stick, with particular care for the human side of AI-driven change.

 Experience and qualifications 

 The ideal candidate will:

• 
 Have 10+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, international transformation or strategic initiatives, ideally combining strategy or transformation consulting with in-house experience in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

• 
 Bring a proven track record of measurable outcomes (revenue, cost, efficiency, adoption, customer experience), not just projects delivered.

• 
 Have a strong customer mindset: see internal work as a way to serve customers, and use that lens to set priorities.

• 
 Use AI agents and assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) hands-on every day, with concrete examples of skills, agents or workflows they have built.

• 
 Have designed or delivered AI-enabled processes, with a pragmatic view of AI's value, limits and risks.

• 
 Be strongly data-driven: analyze business data themselves (spreadsheets, SQL or BI tools, AI-assisted analysis) to build business cases and track results.

• 
 Demonstrate strong change management, stakeholder management and communication skills, having led people through significant change and influenced executives and operational teams alike.

• 
 Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them flexibly rather than by the book.

• 
 Thrive in ambiguity: decide with partial information and adapt the plan without losing sight of the goal.

• 
 Show strong curiosity and learn new domains quickly. Go-To-Market experience is a plus.

• 
 Be fluent in English, written and spoken. French is a plus.

 In-office culture 

 We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

 Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

 We value diversity, equity, and inclusion 

 At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

 Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Code Quality
jobs.description:
Position description 

 As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents. 

 The team: 

 You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence. 

 What will you own: 

• 
 The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

• 
 Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete. 

• 
 New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code. 

• 
 Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed. 

• 
 Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions. 

 What you will do 

 You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

• 
 Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

• 
 Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

• 
 Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

• 
 Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development

 Experience and qualifications 

 Must-haves 

• 
 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development. 

• 
 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment. 

• 
 Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development. 

• 
 Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty. 

• 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 

 Nice to have 

• 
 Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem. 

• 
 Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work. 

• 
 Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins. 

• 
 Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences. 

 If you meet most of the must-haves and this work interests you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn’t match every point. 

 Benefits of Working with Sonar: 

• We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

• We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

• Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually. 

• Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.

• Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.
